$schema: AX.W62 disposition register — machine-readable BOOK/ARCHIVED/RETIRED rows + their named triggers.
doc: A deferral with a named trigger is only honest if a gate RE-EVALUATES the trigger each close. proof:disposition-live parses this file and FAILS the close if a book/archived row's trigger now re-evaluates MET (e.g. a ≥2-consumer threshold the constellation now crosses) while the row is still booked. The chronic it kills: the native-drawer ≥2-consumer trigger was MET at AT and rode BOOK'd five tranches; the AN ARCHIVED-on-2-consumer-gate items were write-once-watch-never. A trigger of kind 'min-consumers' is MET when at least n DISTINCT present consumer repos (constellation.presentConsumers, self excluded) contain a line matching the grep pattern. AY.W-CARRY onboards the full AT W0-L4 ledger BOOK set + the G-4/5/6 AX-promised rows so the register is the ledger's machine MIRROR; the register-COMPLETENESS clause (proof-disposition-live.mjs) cross-checks every docs/tranches/AY/audit/deferred-ledger-manifest.json bookId against this items set. A 'retired' row is coverage-satisfying but NOT trigger-evaluated (it carries a 'successor' field naming its exact destination). RECONCILE (BB.W-NDA-DECIDE): the native-drawer chronic this register names as its founding disease is now DECIDED-TERMINAL — at BB the §0 evidence pass found the host was pruned at AY (077fe58f), the trigger re-evaluates 0 present consumers, speedtest's BB ask-brief names none, and the originating mobile-bottom-sheet need is covered by <Drawer mode="live-behind"> + the vaul-vue upstream limit; the row (`native-drawer-as-asChild`) is flipped book→retired with a recorded rationale + successor, so this `doc`'s 'rode BOOK'd five tranches' sentence is now GENEALOGY (the history of the disease the gate was built to kill), not a live un-resolved carry — the prose-`≥2` was never machine-real and the five-tranche silent ride ENDS at BB.

selfTest.comment: A synthetic always-MET book row the gate evaluates every run to prove its detector is load-bearing: every present consumer imports @mkbabb/glass-ui, so n:1 is trivially met. If the detector does NOT classify this as a violation, the gate is broken and reds loudly (the acceptance-is-the-inverse contract).

Re-evaluates un-MET among present consumers — legitimately booked. The FOUNDING chronic (AY.W-NDA): trigger met-in-prose at AT, rode BOOK'd five tranches before this gate existed; now a watched WATCH row that REDs the instant a 2nd consumer imports dialog-native. DISTINCT from glass-dialog-native-pilot (#34): this is the as/asChild polymorphism EXTENSION on the native dialog; #34 is the demo-gated component's Baseline-Widely graduation. HISTORY (inert): the trigger is kept as genealogy on the now-retired row — a retired row is NOT trigger-evaluated (proof-disposition-live.mjs booked-set = {book,archived}), so this trigger no longer reds the close; it is the AT→BB record of what the watch watched.

items.rationale: BB.W-NDA-DECIDE — the FOUNDING chronic DECIDED-TERMINAL by §0 evidence (build-vs-retire → RETIRE). The §0 evidence pass at BB HEAD foreclosed BUILD overwhelmingly: (1) THE HOST WAS PRUNED — `src/components/custom/dialog-native/GlassDialogNative.vue` + its barrel were deleted at AY's OWN W-PRUNE (`077fe58f`, RETIRE-FULL), the SAME tranche the AY.W-NDA prose claimed it 'real and shipping'; there is no `dialog-native` dir at HEAD and 0 `GlassDialogNative`/`dialog-native` references in src/ or demo/ — nothing to extend. (2) THE TRIGGER RE-EVALUATES 0 — the `min-consumers` n:2 grep matched 0 of 8 present consumers with EVERY sibling on disk (keyframes.js/value.js/fourier-analysis{,/web}/words/bbnf-lang/bbnf-buddy/speedtest all 0); speedtest, the AT-cited firm consumer, → 0. (3) THE AUTHORITATIVE PRESENT ASK NAMES NONE — speedtest's BB ask-brief (glass-ui-BB-ask-brief.md) enumerates 5 P0 + 4 P1 + P2 primitives, zero drawer/native-dialog/asChild. (4) MUSTER IS ABSENT from the constellation and would not match (`MobileInstrumentSheet` ≠ `dialog-native`) — the AT prose-`≥2` was never machine-real. (5) THE ORIGINATING NEED IS COVERED — the mobile bottom-sheet the AT origin pointed at is the SHIPPED `<Drawer mode="live-behind">` (AN.W3 peek/half/full detented sheet); the vaul `activeSnapPoint` re-snap bug the origin cited is a documented UPSTREAM vaul-vue limitation, not a glass-ui native host to build. The five-tranche silent ride (AT→AU→AV→AW→AX→AY→AZ→BA) ENDS here: a `retired` row carries no `min-consumers` watch, so it is structurally impossible to re-book.
